$25/month for one seat, covering every project the company runs on Supabase — currently the Furies Scheduler and the BD Dashboard. One seat and one bill, not one per project, so adding another project does not add another $25. Note that a Supabase seat covers people, not usage: database size, bandwidth and egress are metered on top of the seat once a project outgrows the included allowance, so this is a floor rather than a hard ceiling.
